name: myst-dev-kit
description: Team dev kit: 24 skills - engineering/productivity (spec, TDD, triage, debugging, grilling...) plus the team process rules as on-demand skills (review-and-submit, changelist-verification, pre-implementation-gate...), sync-build-submit + package commands, and the Submit-Audit warning bridge. Reviews run INLINE via the review-changes skill: the two reviewer agents ship as Markdown and Codex agents are TOML, so nothing here consumes them (Codex does have a subagent mechanism - porting them is open work, not a missing feature). See docs/tool-capability-matrix.md.

interface.shortDescription: Myst team skills, review workflows, and Submit-Audit warning
